tasks_completed.description: Added fail-closed preflight before daemon /spawn-session restore calls.
tasks_completed.changes: daemon_spawn_session now proves the running daemon's reachable JS import graph has route evidence containing spawn-session+resumeSessionId and launcher evidence containing resumeSessionId+--resume from files not newer than the daemon process start before it can POST /spawn-session with a resume id.
tasks_completed.rationale: An old live daemon can ignore resumeSessionId; preflight failure now logs an operator message requiring a compatible happy-cli build/restart through the sanctioned safe-daemon-restart workflow and returns before spawning.

tasks_completed.description: Strengthened post-spawn verification to require agent-resume mapping proof.
tasks_completed.changes: Success is no longer counted from Happy session id presence alone when a non-empty resume id was requested; Claude must map through claudeSessionId/resume metadata and Codex through codexThreadId/thread-id equivalent metadata.
tasks_completed.rationale: This prevents false restore counts when a daemon creates a fresh Happy session instead of resuming the requested underlying Claude/Codex session.

safety_behavior: No restore POST is issued for a non-empty resume id unless live-daemon support is proven first.

If support proof is missing, stale, or newer than daemon process start, the session fails closed and logs: build/install compatible happy-cli and restart through the sanctioned safe-daemon-restart workflow; not spawning.
After POST, a returned Happy session id must be present in /list and must expose matching underlying resume metadata for the requested flavor before daemon_tracked_restored can increment.

For Claude, accepted proof fields are claudeSessionId plus explicit resume metadata fields; for Codex, accepted proof fields include codexThreadId/threadId/codexSessionId plus explicit resume metadata fields. happySessionId alone is insufficient for non-empty requested resume ids.
preserved_protections: Tombstone filtering and skip accounting unchanged.
Codex per-thread spawn lock remains in place.

git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: The recovery script sent resumeSessionId to /spawn-session but old running daemon builds may only accept directory/sessionId and ignore resumeSessionId.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: The script now proves live daemon resume-aware support before spawning and proves daemon child-to-agent resume mapping after spawning.
